Overview

Demo version: every figure, customer, plant and work centre here belongs to the fictional company Acme Pumps. The real dashboard loads my daily SAP downloads (sales CMII, order costs, operations, TB, WIP, FI vs CO-PA, claims) and keeps the history in a database.

    WIP report by plant

    Action plan

    Built from this period's flags · action, owner and due date are editable

    Duties

    Monthly duties fall on a working day (WD) of the month, skipping weekends and SA public holidays, and reset each month. One-off duties stay until you tick or remove them. Ticks and updates are saved in this browser on this device only.

    Outstanding email queries

    An automatic check runs on weekday mornings while your PC is on with the Claude app open, adding new queries here. Ticking a box or writing an update doesn't change anything in Outlook.
